text: @dsh-external/dsh-compaction-current-model 是面向 DSH Web 的模型路由插件，通过 bundle 插入及会话事件监听，跟踪手动 /compact，并将压缩摘要请求改用前端当前选中的模型。它只调整手动压缩期间 purpose 为 compaction 的 llm/stream；自动压缩、普通对话和冻结请求保持原样。适合切换模型后希望手动压缩摘要跟随当前选择的用户。需要 DSH 提供 sessions 与 agentDefaultModel 服务；代码未配置外部 API 或密钥。

@dsh-external/dsh-compaction-current-model routes manual DSH Web /compact summaries to the model selected in the frontend. It tracks manual compaction events and changes only the summary stream; automatic compaction and ordinary chat pass through. It uses DSH session and model-selection services.
切换模型以后，怎么让手动 /compact 用当前选中的模型？
DSH 手动压缩摘要总跟着旧模型，能不能跟前端选择同步？
Make manual DSH compaction use the model I just selected in the frontend.
@dsh-external/dsh-compaction-current-model「手动压缩跟随当前模型」：/compact 摘要流使用前端当前选择的模型；自动压缩与普通对话不变。
@dsh-external/dsh-compaction-current-model: manual summaries follow the selected model.

@dsh-external/dsh-compaction-current-model README · @dsh-external/dsh-compaction-current-model：DSH host bundle that fixes a manual-compaction model-selection bug for
DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.7`:

- Before the fix, `/compact`（手动压缩）summarization could use the session's
  last routed model even after the frontend model picker changed.
- This plugin tracks the durable manual-compaction span
  (`compaction/start` with `turn: null`) and rewrites the summarization
  `llm/stream` to `agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()` — the model the
  frontend currently shows.

@dsh-external/dsh-compaction-current-model README · @dsh-external/dsh-compaction-current-model：Automatic compaction, ordinary chat requests, and frozen LLM requests are
never rewritten.

@dsh-external/dsh-compaction-current-model README · Install：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:JK-LIL/dsh-compaction-current-model
```

or from a local tarball:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-compaction-current-model-0.1.0.tgz
```

then restart the web profile and run `/compact` after switching models.

@dsh-external/dsh-compaction-current-model README · Compatibility：- Built against DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.7` (source mode or installed build).
- Runtime-import-free: the plugin only calls the Cordis context and standard
  session/LLM events, so it has no package dependencies of its own.
- If a future DSH version changes the `compaction/start` owner marker,
  `llm/stream` request shape, or `agentDefaultModel`, review this plugin before
  upgrading.

@dsh-external/dsh-compaction-current-model README · Verification：From the plugin package:

```powershell
npm run typecheck
npm run build
```

Runtime acceptance: start DSH web, switch the model picker to a model different
from the last routed request, then run `/compact` and confirm the recorded
`compaction/summary` provider/model matches the frontend selection.
